FL-CONT-001.statement: A receiving harness MUST reconcile continuity against the current work state and checkout before acting on it.

FL-CLAIM-001.statement: Every harness MUST consume the canonical validated claim-state resolver.

FL-CLAIM-002.statement: Readers without task-recovery schema v1 support MUST refuse claim ownership mutation.

FL-CLAIM-003.statement: A reader without validated claim projection MUST fail closed.

FL-WS-001.statement: A bound task MUST validate the current workspace before a task mutation or ForgeLoop-owned verification launch.

FL-HANDOFF-001.statement: A canonical handoff MUST remain an immutable protocol-derived snapshot.

FL-SCOPE-001.statement: A verification scope MUST narrow execution only from current canonical evidence.

FL-ATTEST-001.statement: A code attestation MUST bind exact source content to a valid completion receipt and event-ledger checkpoint.

FL-ATTEST-002.statement: An integration MUST consume the canonical attestation result and preserve its trust distinctions.

FL-ATTEST-003.statement: A signing integration MUST keep private keys, OIDC tokens, and credentials outside ForgeLoop artifacts.

FL-SQ-001.statement: Structural-quality evidence MUST remain provider-neutral, task-bound, delta-first, and separate from behavioral, security, performance, accessibility, and publication truth.

FL-SQ-002.statement: A structural-quality integration MUST preserve unavailable, malformed, stale, incomparable, and blocked provider results without promoting them to PASS.

FL-PROVIDER-001.statement: The providerExtensions capability MUST remain provider-neutral and experimental, and MUST NOT imply a public generic provider registry API.

FL-PROVIDER-002.statement: Every advertised provider kind MUST deny lifecycle, completion, and evidence authority.

FL-PROVIDER-003.statement: Provider results MUST cross a strict JSON snapshot boundary before consumer use.

FL-PROVIDER-004.statement: The generic provider registry MUST remain absent from the public package subpath exports.
